svg.title: Heartbeat viewport contact owner-wiring scar
svg.desc: A non-raster warm-wall diagram showing the existing Operator Overlay owner measuring live selected and keyboard-focused heartbeat controls, rejecting an offscreen selection as visible contact, choosing the visible keyboard-focused fallback, preserving that semantic anchor through mutation, and distinguishing rebuild-caused keyboard focus loss from a different competing keyboard focus after layout. Runtime Android and TalkBack behavior remain unproven.
svg.text: WARM WALL / VISIBLE CONTACT ≠ SEMANTIC SELECTION
OWNER VISIBILITY GATE SOURCE-WIRED • RUNTIME UNPROVEN • TALKBACK FOCUS UNCLAIMED • NOT PHONE DELIVERY
Semantic id survives; live geometry says it does not own contact.
Mutation may move the anchor or destroy its old native Button. Empty keyboard focus can be rebuild-caused.
Same captured selection + no focus → restore may proceed. Different non-empty focus → ticket dies.
Partial intersection counts. Exact-edge / offscreen / zero-width do not. No geometry-only Christmas twitch. Source wiring ≠ runtime proof.
No phone surface consumed. No second renderer hatched. Focus-loss distinction does not claim keyboard or TalkBack focus survived.
